options.name: Now
options.line: KVELD and three links. It hides as you scroll down, and the logo lands on the end of the tour.

options.name: Halo Mark
options.line: The hero's arch as the logo, all seven sections as tabs, a light that slides to where you are.

options.name: Fretboard
options.line: KVELD's own headstock as the logo, the sections laid out as frets, a fingertip of light in the one you are in.

options.name: Index
options.line: A quiet header that says where you are, and Menu opens the seven as big lines across the screen.
